entries.topic: D172 OBPP v2 valid login still fails at isolated session activation due to existing Firebase UID ':' validator
facts: Owner tested signed OBPP v2 on device and reported 503 OBPP_SESSION_ACTIVATION_UNAVAILABLE after credentials accepted. This localizes the observed failure to Worker->InventoryCore /obpp1291/session/activate, not initial Firebase password validation.

Existing InventoryCore creates managed ADMIN/PICKPACK_ADMIN account user IDs with `${targetRole.toLowerCase()}:${username}` and Firebase UID inherits user_id in ensureFirebaseUid. The D172 isolated session activate handler incorrectly enforced /^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,128}$/; it rejects colon-containing UIDs with HTTP400 INVALID_UID, which Worker E010 safely maps to 503 OBPP_SESSION_ACTIVATION_UNAVAILABLE. Exact root cause proved by comparing registered user creation, Firebase UID linking and session activation code.

D172 E012 changes only the dedicated obpp_sessions UID validator to bounded /^[A-Za-z0-9_-][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,127}$/; SQL operations remain parameterized and session/check unchanged.
